Use `snl macro-kind usages` to find all entities that currently use one Macro Kind before changing or deleting it.

### Agent procedure
1. Supply the exact macro-kind ID and inspect the complete structured result.
2. Keep the kind while usages remain unless the user explicitly authorizes a coordinated replacement.

### Machine-use contract
Invoke `snl macro-kind usages` with an explicit `--root` and `--json`. Treat returned IDs and revisions as opaque. Branch on the structured status and exit code; do not scrape human-formatted output or edit `.SNL_Doc` files directly.
